title: Electromotive force correct
description: Essential: The student must state the electromotive force as 5 V.

title: Internal resistance correct
description: Essential: The student must state the internal resistance as 5 Ω.

title: Maximum charge correct
description: Essential: The student must calculate the maximum charge on the capacitor as 7.5 × 10⁻⁶ C.

title: Apply closed-circuit Ohm's law
description: Important: The student must set up the equations E = U + Ir for both endpoints A and B using data from the graph.

title: Interpret graph data
description: Important: The student must correctly extract the terminal voltage and current values for points A and B from the provided figure.

title: Analyze parallel circuit segment
description: Important: The student must correctly determine the voltage across the capacitor by analyzing the resistance in the branch parallel to R1.

title: Use Q = CV
description: Optional: The student correctly applies the capacitance formula Q = C * U to find the maximum charge.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: The student makes a sign error in the Ohm's law equations or reports a final answer with incorrect units (e.g., V for Ω).

title: Misidentify graph points
description: Pitfall: The student misreads the coordinates for points A or B on the U-I graph, leading to incorrect voltages or currents.
